children: : Egyptian Gulf Bank (EG Bank) has entered a strategic partnership with Azimut Investments – Egypt to strengthen its wealth management offering and expand the range of investment solutions available to its clients, according to a press release.

This is part of EG Bank’s strategy to provide a more integrated financial experience that extends beyond traditional banking services by offering diversified, professionally managed investment solutions tailored to clients’ financial goals and individual needs.

Under the partnership, EG Bank clients will gain access to a broader range of investment solutions across asset classes, including gold and equities. The offering will enable clients to diversify their portfolios in line with their investment objectives while benefiting from Azimut Egypt’s specialized expertise in asset management and investment funds.

The move reflects EG Bank’s objectives to enhance its wealth management services, expand its portfolio of financial products, and connect traditional banking services with specialized investment solutions through a more comprehensive and seamless client experience.
